_comment: Autofocus section added to libcamera's stock ov5647 tuning for OV5647 modules with a lens motor
(AD5398-style chip at I2C 0x0c). Used by fpgas-cam-lens. Contrast autofocus only: this sensor has
no phase detection, so the pdaf values are inert.
map: lens position in dioptres -> lens code. Measured 2026-10-04 on two modules about 10 cm (10
dioptres) above an Acorn: sharpest at codes 320 and 384, and nothing moves below about 190.
retrigger_ratio 0.3 / retrigger_delay 60: scan once when the stream starts, then hold. With the
0.8 / 10 of libcamera's imx708 tuning the lens re-scanned about every 80 s on a still scene (blinking LEDs change the
contrast) and came to rest at a different code each time. step_frames 6: the stream runs at 6 fps.
